svg.title: Dairy processing — Main process
svg.desc: Main process. 9 equipment references and 8 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Main process · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
